pigment_change_note.design: Clip-to-base is encoded WITHOUT changing any existing public struct or exhaustive enum, so render-cpu/render-gpu/interop-psd/develop and their literals still compile: MaskFormat (already non_exhaustive) gains BaseAlpha; MaskInput::clip_to_base() is the one canonical encoding (key 0, empty placement, zero hash, density 1, not inverted); PlanError gains ClipWithoutBase/ClipFields/ClipPassThrough; Operator::Mask(BaseAlpha) key 'clip_to_base', intrinsic Approximate; RenderBackend gains default method supports_clip_to_base() = false and admit() refuses any plan using the route as Unsupported{operator:'clip_to_base'} before consulting backend.exactness(), so a backend that has not opted in can never render a clipped layer unclipped. The base is implicit (nearest earlier unclipped layer, Photoshop rule), so an explicit clip_base index would be redundant; validate enforces a base exists, canonical fields, and no pass-through reference.
pigment_change_note.semantics_recorded_in_doc: run [base, c1..cn] = isolated unit G: G starts as base content with the base's own mask; each ci composited onto G with its own mode/opacity/fill, source alpha multiplied by base alpha, G alpha held at base alpha; G composited onto the parent backdrop with the BASE's mode/opacity/fill. Approximate: Photoshop's exact rule UNVERIFIED (oracle pending).

decisions_and_readings: Return shape is a struct (ExtendedLowering), a superset of the brief's tuple: the MaskTable and the ledger are needed by the caller.

Hue/Saturation bands: all-zero bands are the identity (PSD writes six defaults) and are ignored; a band with any non-zero shift is refused hue_saturation_bands (the brief's 'any band' read as 'any band that does something').

Exposure use_legacy has no pigment counterpart: refused exposure_use_legacy. Channel enablement (channel_blend) other than all on: refused channel_blend_unsupported. Interior/clipped-effects and transparency-shapes toggles only matter with effects/knockout and are not carried (they are not refused).
Knockout Inherited resolves through the containment parent chain (Photoshop rule UNVERIFIED, D5 11); root layers with Blend-If, knockout or effects are wrapped so the wrapper layer carries the entry.

Effect colours: another profile than the document blending profile is refused (no conversion in composite); in a linear_light plan only channel values 0 and 1 are accepted (the profile transfer is not decoded here). Stack scale other than 100 is refused. visible_in_editor and anti_alias are not render inputs here (anti_alias only acts on a contour, and only a linear contour is accepted).
Spread and choke percent/100 (lead decision, spec unit conflict D19); glow jitter on a solid colour is passed as 0 and reported glow_jitter_ignored_solid_colour (lead decision, D5 16).
